name: Anthropomorphic cat shopkeeper game (Recettear/Stardew Valley inspired)

mentions.name: Anthropomorphic cat shopkeeper game (Recettear/Stardew Valley inspired)
mentions.description: A game inspired by a blend of Recettear and Stardew Valley in which the player shopkeeper is an anthropomorphic cat. It is being built on personal time as a gift for a family member, and serves as a way to practice working with AI coding tools like Claude Code through vibe-coding.
mentions.audience: AI tooling is arriving in the author's embedded software work, so they want to learn to interact with AI coding tools like Claude Code more effectively and efficiently.
